column5: The clown was oh so proud to bring laughter to so many people! Their hard work had paid off!
At the time, it fascinated me that the audience was laughing as they watched these death defying stunts!
Such an interesting little trick from the clown, and I wanted a little trick of my own.
An audience would never laugh watching someone near death, and yet with some trickery they did.
An audience would never laugh at the clown’s hard work, but just like the clown, I now have a little trick too!
